quote: Identities were separated from the analysed records, which retain only a participant code, age band, gender and education; the distribution and return e-mails are retained in the authors' records.
replacement: Two recruitment decisions were deliberate. The Stage-2 facility of [2] was not re-used: its residents already carried direct experience of the coupled system, and prior exposure would have contaminated a first-contact test of the decoupled frame, so a separate cohort was a design choice rather than only a constraint. Distribution also extended beyond the authors' immediate circle through onward (snowball) forwarding by the receiving organisations and contacts, so that a portion of participants were personally unknown to the authors, reducing the risk that participation reflected personal obligation to the researcher. Onward forwarding also leaves the cohort without a compiled invitation denominator: the 120 participants are those whose returned materials were compiled, not the number of people to whom the build was forwarded, so no response rate can be computed and every proportion reported below is conditional on the observed file-returning sample.

Counting a participant first as an initial dropout and then as returning inside the same window presupposes a disengagement checkpoint earlier than the window's end; the aggregate register preserves neither that checkpoint nor per-participant session dates, so the timing rule behind the dropout and return classifications cannot be reconstructed from the aggregates, and the counts are reported as compiled classifications subject to this definitional limit;

quote: A three-arm randomised within-cohort study is pre-specified to convert the present associations into causal tests: Arm 1, the coupled game (control); Arm 2, the decoupled coordination-challenge framing; Arm 3, the coupled game with a structured coaching layer. The primary endpoint is re-engagement within seven days of first failure.
replacement:
A. The Stage-3B component study as commenced. After the present results were in hand, a component study (Stage 3B of the programme) was pre-specified — its protocol and analysis hierarchy are repository-dated 8–9 August 2026, before recruitment; it is not registry-registered — and commenced. It is a silent 2×2 design crossing adaptive (A) against static (B) difficulty presentation with zero-failure (ZF) against game-over (GO) failure modes, in a new, remotely recruited cohort: assignment is drawn at random per participant at first enrolment and persisted in the browser's local storage; the adaptive arm's rule agent steps difficulty up above 80% clearance and eases it below 40%, while the static arm runs at a fixed ×0.85 pace with coaching suppressed; consent is recorded in-build before play; and one confirmatory contrast was pre-specified (adaptive versus static on questionnaire item D2, willingness to play regularly, top-two-box, pooled across failure modes), with the failure-mode factor and the interaction exploratory. Builds were distributed 10–12 August 2026 through five device-tagged copies, input-mode logging was added on 13 August, and a frozen study edition (build stamp Alpine_Coordination_Game_v3.1s_Stage3B_FROZEN20260915; twenty distributor-tagged copies hosted on GitHub Pages) opened a clean-run window from 15 September to 15 October 2026. The record at the cut-off of this paper (26 September 2026) is descriptive: one verified return (15 August 2026, on the August build); five returns received on 15 September were excluded as researcher-solicited plays on the pre-freeze 13-August edition, all in one arm; and no clean-run return was on record. No confirmatory analysis is reported, and the paper's claims do not depend on one. The study was designed to examine the adaptive-learning direction of Section V.D, not the coupling claim, because clinical framing is not a factor in it.

B. Why the learning measurement must be re-articulated first. In the course of that study the authors judged that its learning measurement was not articulated to the adaptive-learning construct, and it is no longer used as the test of that construct. The build records immediate task performance (clearance on the course played), which is not durable learning; course forms across sessions were not equated, so performance under changing difficulty or assistance is not comparable across sessions; the adaptive arm bundles difficulty adjustment with coaching, so its contrast estimates an adaptive-support package rather than difficulty adjustment alone; and the unit of randomisation and each participant's first-exposure version require per-participant recording. A test of adaptive learning therefore needs, before any confirmatory contrast: separate reporting of participation, performance and learning; equated reference conditions (the same course form and assistance level at comparable checkpoints); and an unassisted delayed test on an equated form as the learning outcome, with difficulty, assistance and task version recorded for every run.

C. Future work (proposed, not commenced). A three-arm randomised within-cohort study is proposed — it has not been commenced and no protocol for it is repository-dated — to convert the present associations into causal tests: Arm 1, the coupled game (control); Arm 2, the decoupled coordination-challenge framing; Arm 3, the coupled game with a structured coaching layer. Its primary endpoint would be re-engagement within seven days of first failure.

quote: The study adds instruments this deployment lacked: baseline FES-I, a validated motivational measure administered before any outcome is observed, WTA/WTP elicitation after the first session, and harmonised session-level logging with timestamps.
replacement: Such a study would add instruments this deployment lacked: baseline FES-I [13], a validated motivational measure administered before any outcome is observed, WTA/WTP elicitation after the first session, harmonised session-level logging with timestamps, and a group-level component in response to the collective-narrative rival named in Section VII.

Hypotheses and endpoints will be pre-registered before data collection begins.
replacement: A nested-model quantitative comparison — specified in the programme as a prospective analysis architecture, with no model yet fitted — could be run alongside it, to test whether prospectively measured FIAS operators add incremental explanatory power beyond demographics and senior-technology-acceptance constructs, with likelihood-ratio, information-criterion, discrimination, calibration and decision-curve analyses, and with any FIAS predictor excluding the elements that define the outcome. Hypotheses and endpoints for these studies should be pre-specified and publicly registered before any data collection; no registration exists at the time of writing, and no commitment to run either study is made here.
